name: Goldman Sachs

roles.title: Engineering (Software Engineer / Strats)
roles.notes: Goldman's careers site lists Engineering as a division with its own pages; the students/prepare page states engineering applicants take a HackerRank assessment.

roles.title: Quantitative Strategy (Strats). Securities Division
roles.notes: Track definition maps to derivatives pricing, numerical methods and risk analytics; division names are sourced, the 'Strats' title is common usage rather than a fetched page claim.

roles.title: Asset & Wealth Management Engineering
roles.notes: The careers site's divisions include Asset & Wealth Management, where quant-dev work concentrates on portfolio and risk tooling.

publishedExpectations.claim: Published campus process: if selected after application review, candidates take 'a video interview, which will take approximately 30 minutes to complete. Engineering applicants will be asked to take a HackerRank assessment.'

Published final round: 'If selected following your HireVue interview, you'll be invited to a series of final round interviews. Typically, we conduct between two and five interviews for campus hires, depending on the division.'
Goldman Sachs states: 'We actively seek to recruit talented people from all academic backgrounds into our university programs and entry level positions.'

The prepare page walks through plan-your-timeline, choose-your-path, connect-with-us events, submit-your-application, first interview and Superday stages, and notes applications are evaluated throughout the recruiting season.

notes: Goldman Sachs is among the best-documented banks here: its own prepare page names the video-interview (~30 minutes), the HackerRank assessment for engineering applicants, the HireVue platform, and a Superday of typically two to five interviews for campus hires. It also advertises division-agnostic academic recruiting. Community-reported patterns (unverified): HackerRank content skewing to data structures/algorithms with some math, division-specific technicals (pricing/PDEs for strats seats), and a values-focused final round. The bank's own pages do not publish pass criteria or question types, so specifics beyond the process structure should be treated as unconfirmed.
